nodes.description: Address of the token/WETH Uniswap pair obtained from the factory; used as the external IERC20 target for totalSupply() calls and as a fee-exempt sender.
Public IUniswapV2Factory reference; declared but never assigned in initialize, so getPair on it would revert.
Internal address of the WETH token used as one side of the Uniswap pair lookup.
Address of the FUEL token; part of the pair lookup in initialize.
Address of the fuel vault; when it is the sender, transfers bypass fees.
Public uint8 fee multiplier (per 1000), clamped by type to 255 (25.5%).
Cached LP total supply of the pair, used to forbid liquidity withdrawals by comparing against the live supply.
Boolean pause flag checked at the start of calculateAmountsAfterFee.
Private owner address maintained by OwnableUpgradeSafe; gates all onlyOwner functions.
Public initializer that sets fuel/WETH addresses, resolves the Uniswap pair, sets feePercentX100 to 11 and paused to false.
onlyOwner function that flips the paused flag controlling fee calculations.
onlyOwner function that writes the fee multiplier used in the fee arithmetic.
onlyOwner function that sets the fee-exempt vault address.
Publicly callable function that reads the pair's totalSupply and caches it in lastTotalSupplyOfLPTokens.
Public fee-calculation entrypoint; reads the pair supply, enforces the no-withdrawal check, computes fee vs transfer amounts and refreshes the cached supply.
OwnableUpgradeSafe access-control modifier requiring _owner == _msgSender().
Internal view returning msg.sender; the only source of caller identity for ownership checks.
onlyOwner ownership transfer with zero-address check.
onlyOwner function setting _owner to address(0).
msg.sender: attacker-controlled caller identity used for ownership checks and for the fee-exemption branches.
External IERC20(tokenUniswapPair).totalSupply() call executed inside calculateAmountsAfterFee before the cached supply is updated.
External IUniswapV2Factory(_uniswapFactory).getPair(WETH, FUEL) call in initialize; the factory address is fully caller-supplied and unvalidated.
Arithmetic amount.mul(feePercentX100).div(1000) computing the fee distributor amount.
Arithmetic amount.sub(transferToFeeDistributorAmount) computing the net transfer amount.
External IERC20(tokenUniswapPair).totalSupply() call in the permissionless sync() function.
Function parameter _fuelAddress of initialize.
Function parameter _WETHAddress of initialize.
Function parameter _uniswapFactory of initialize, used as the target of the external getPair call.
Function parameter _pause of setPaused.
Function parameter _feeMultiplier of setFeeMultiplier.
Function parameter _fuelVaultAddress of setfuelVaultAddress.
Function parameter sender of calculateAmountsAfterFee, compared against the pair and vault addresses.
Function parameter recipient of calculateAmountsAfterFee (unused).
Function parameter amount of calculateAmountsAfterFee, used in fee arithmetic.
Function parameter newOwner of transferOwnership.
Local _LPSupplyOfPairTotal in calculateAmountsAfterFee holding the live pair supply.
Local _LPSupplyOfPairTotal in sync() holding the live pair supply.
Local transferToAmount returned by calculateAmountsAfterFee.
Local transferToFeeDistributorAmount returned by calculateAmountsAfterFee.

edges.reason: initialize writes tokenUniswapPair with the result of the factory getPair lookup.
initialize writes WETHAddress from the caller-supplied parameter.
initialize writes fuelTokenAddress from the caller-supplied parameter.
initialize initializes feePercentX100 to 11.
initialize sets paused to false.
onlyOwner setPaused mutates the paused flag that gates fee calculations.
onlyOwner setFeeMultiplier writes the fee multiplier consumed by the fee arithmetic; no bounds check beyond the uint8 type.
onlyOwner setfuelVaultAddress changes the address that bypasses fees.
permissionless sync() overwrites the cached lastTotalSupplyOfLPTokens with the live pair supply.
calculateAmountsAfterFee refreshes lastTotalSupplyOfLPTokens after computing amounts.
calculateAmountsAfterFee requires paused == false before proceeding.
calculateAmountsAfterFee reads feePercentX100 to compute the fee via mul/div.
calculateAmountsAfterFee compares sender against fuelVaultAddress to skip fees.
calculateAmountsAfterFee compares sender against tokenUniswapPair and calls totalSupply on it.
onlyOwner reads _owner when checking the caller.
onlyOwner gates setPaused.
onlyOwner gates setFeeMultiplier.
onlyOwner gates setfuelVaultAddress.
onlyOwner gates transferOwnership.
onlyOwner gates renounceOwnership.
_msgSender result is assigned to _owner during initialization of the Ownable module.
transferOwnership writes the new owner into _owner.
renounceOwnership zeroes out _owner.
msg.sender flows into the onlyOwner comparison, making the caller identity the access-control predicate.
msg.sender is returned verbatim by _msgSender().
msg.sender implicitly determines the sender argument used in the fee-exemption branches of calculateAmountsAfterFee.
calculateAmountsAfterFee invokes the external IERC20(tokenUniswapPair).totalSupply() call.
initialize performs an external getPair call on the caller-supplied factory address.
calculateAmountsAfterFee computes the fee with mul/div on attacker-influenced amount and configured multiplier.
calculateAmountsAfterFee computes the net transfer with subtraction of the fee amount.
sync() reads the pair supply through an external call.

The external totalSupply() call on tokenUniswapPair occurs before lastTotalSupplyOfLPTokens is updated, allowing a malicious pair to reenter calculateAmountsAfterFee and observe/manipulate the stale cached supply.
Permissionless sync() performs an external totalSupply() call before writing the cache, permitting reentrant re-invocation.
_fuelAddress parameter is stored into fuelTokenAddress.
_WETHAddress parameter is stored into WETHAddress.
_uniswapFactory parameter is used as the target of the external getPair call.
_pause parameter is written into the paused state variable.
_feeMultiplier parameter is written into feePercentX100 and later drives fee arithmetic.
_fuelVaultAddress parameter is written into fuelVaultAddress.
sender parameter controls the fee-exemption and withdrawal-check branches.
recipient parameter is accepted by calculateAmountsAfterFee though unused.
amount parameter is the operand of the fee mul/div and the subtraction.
newOwner parameter is validated and stored into _owner.
Local _LPSupplyOfPairTotal holds the external totalSupply result used in the withdrawal check and cache update.
Local _LPSupplyOfPairTotal in sync() holds the external totalSupply result written to the cache.
Local transferToAmount is assigned in each branch and returned by calculateAmountsAfterFee.
Local transferToFeeDistributorAmount is produced by the fee arithmetic and consumed by the subtraction.

normalization_plan.reason: _fuelAddress exists only to initialize fuelTokenAddress inside initialize.
_WETHAddress exists only to initialize WETHAddress inside initialize.
_uniswapFactory is used only as the external target of the getPair call inside initialize.
_pause is the sole input written to the paused flag by setPaused.
_feeMultiplier is the sole input written to feePercentX100 by setFeeMultiplier.
_fuelVaultAddress is the sole input written to fuelVaultAddress.
sender is a formal parameter of calculateAmountsAfterFee used in its branch conditions.
recipient is a formal parameter of calculateAmountsAfterFee (currently unused).
amount is the operand of the fee mul/div arithmetic inside calculateAmountsAfterFee.
newOwner is the sole input stored into _owner by transferOwnership.
The local supply snapshot is a temporary of calculateAmountsAfterFee feeding the withdrawal check and cache update.
The local supply snapshot is a temporary of sync() written into lastTotalSupplyOfLPTokens.
transferToAmount is a return temporary of calculateAmountsAfterFee.
transferToFeeDistributorAmount is the value subtracted from amount in the fee arithmetic.
